description: A React + TypeScript todo application with full CRUD operations, local storage persistence, and status-based filtering.
non_goals: Backend/server — all data stays in localStorage
Due dates, tags, or priority levels
End-to-end testing (unit tests only for this batch)

userStories.title: Bootstrap React + TypeScript project with test harness
userStories.description: Initialize a new React + TypeScript project using Vite, configure ESLint, and set up Vitest with React Testing Library so future stories have a working test and lint pipeline from day one.
acceptance_criteria: Project initialised with Vite React-TS template (npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts)
Dependencies installed (npm install completes without errors)
Vitest and @testing-library/react are dev dependencies
A trivial placeholder test exists and passes (npm test)
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
npx eslint . passes with zero errors (ESLint configured for TS + React)
Dev server starts without errors (verified via npm run dev -- --host)

userStories.title: Define Todo data model and create in-memory state
userStories.description: Define the Todo TypeScript interface and implement React state management (useState) for a list of todos, including an AddTodo form that creates new items.
acceptance_criteria: Todo interface defined with fields: id (string), title (string), status ('active' | 'completed'), createdAt (string ISO timestamp)
App renders an input field and an 'Add' button
Typing a title and clicking Add (or pressing Enter) adds a new todo with status 'active' to the list
Empty title submission is prevented (button disabled or no-op)
Newly added todo appears in the rendered list immediately
Unit test: adding a todo increases the displayed list count by 1
npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npx eslint . all pass

userStories.title: Display todo list with completion toggle and delete
userStories.description: Render the list of todos with the ability to toggle a todo between active/completed and to delete a todo entirely.
acceptance_criteria: Each todo item displays its title and a checkbox reflecting its status
Clicking the checkbox toggles status between 'active' and 'completed'
Completed todos have a visible style difference (e.g. line-through text)
Each todo has a delete button that removes it from the list
Unit test: toggling a todo changes its status in the rendered output
Unit test: deleting a todo removes it from the rendered list
npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npx eslint . all pass

userStories.title: Edit existing todo title inline
userStories.description: Allow users to edit the title of an existing todo by double-clicking it, making the field editable, and saving on Enter or blur.
acceptance_criteria: Double-clicking a todo title switches it to an editable input pre-filled with current title
Pressing Enter or blurring the input saves the new title
Pressing Escape cancels editing and reverts to the original title
Empty title on save either reverts or deletes the todo (choose one, document choice)
Unit test: editing a todo updates its displayed title
npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npx eslint . all pass

userStories.title: Persist todos to localStorage
userStories.description: Sync the todos array to localStorage on every change, and rehydrate from localStorage on app load, so data survives page refreshes.
acceptance_criteria: On every state change, the full todos array is serialised to localStorage under key 'todos'
On app mount, todos are loaded from localStorage if the key exists
If localStorage is empty or missing, the app starts with an empty list (no crash)
Unit test: mock localStorage, add a todo, verify localStorage.setItem is called with correct data
Unit test: mock localStorage with pre-existing data, verify todos load on mount
npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npx eslint . all pass

userStories.title: Filter todos by status
userStories.description: Add filter controls (All / Active / Completed) that show only the matching subset of todos, with a visual indicator of which filter is currently selected.
acceptance_criteria: Three filter buttons rendered: 'All', 'Active', 'Completed'
Default filter is 'All' (shows every todo)
Clicking 'Active' shows only todos with status 'active'
Clicking 'Completed' shows only todos with status 'completed'
Currently active filter button has distinct styling (e.g. bold or highlighted)
A count of visible items is displayed (e.g. '3 items left')
Unit test: with mixed todos, selecting 'Active' filter hides completed items
Unit test: selecting 'Completed' filter hides active items
